verdict.rationale: Modal is a cloud compute platform, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The pack never mentions an MCP server. The official coding-agent skill, llms.txt, CLI and SDKs are adjacent agent aids, not an MCP server, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
